description: Documents the exact MIMII dataset subset used in this project. Every fact is tagged with its source file. Facts that cannot be proven from repository evidence are explicitly marked NOT_VERIFIED_FROM_REPOSITORY_EVIDENCE.

dataset_name.value: MIMII (Malfunctioning Industrial Machine Investigation and Inspection) Dataset

file_naming_convention.value: Sequential zero-padded 8-digit integers (e.g. 00000000.wav, 00000001.wav). No SNR or noise-level encoding in filenames.

snr_subdirectory_structure.value: ABSENT. The on-disk layout is <machine_type>/<machine_id>/<label>/ with no SNR-level subdirectory layer. There is no 6dB/, 0dB/, or -6dB/ directory present.
snr_subdirectory_structure.source: Directly observed: listDirectory(data/raw/MIMII, maxDepth=2) — only fan/, pump/, slider/, valve/ at top level, then id_00/ id_02/ id_04/ id_06/ per type, then normal/ and abnormal/ per ID.

actual_wav_file_counts_on_disk.note: Counted via 'dir /b | find /c .wav' on each subdirectory.
actual_wav_file_counts_on_disk.source: Windows 'dir /b | find /c .wav' executed on each subdirectory

dataset_split_protocol.abnormal_handling: All abnormal recordings go directly to test_abnormal; never used in training or profile construction

verified_train_normal_counts_seed42.note: These counts are asserted at runtime in phase9_train.py against _EXPECTED_TRAIN_NORMAL and _EXPECTED_TRAIN_NORMAL_PER_ID.

phase11_evaluation_sample_counts_seed42.note: Counts from the committed Phase 11 seed_42 evaluation CSVs, verified by generate_phase11_per_type_summary.py.

snr_filtering_in_code.value: NONE. The DatasetLoader and DatasetSplitter contain no SNR-filtering logic. All .wav files found under the MIMII root are loaded unconditionally.
snr_filtering_in_code.source: src/dataset/loader.py (DatasetLoader._load()), src/dataset/scanner.py (scan_audio_files()), src/dataset/metadata.py (extract_metadata()) — no SNR field, no SNR filter

snr_condition.explanation: The MIMII dataset on Zenodo (record 3384388) is distributed as separate archives per SNR level (6dB, 0dB, -6dB) and per machine type. The repository contains no code, configuration, script, README section, or result artifact that specifies which SNR archive(s) were downloaded and extracted. The on-disk directory structure has no SNR subdirectory layer, and filenames carry no SNR encoding. The word 'SNR', 'dB', 'decibel', 'noise', '6dB', '0dB', or '-6dB' does not appear anywhere in the repository (verified by exhaustive findstr search across all .py, .md, .json, .txt, .yaml, .yml files). The actual SNR condition(s) present in data/raw/MIMII/ can only be determined by inspecting the audio content or by knowing which Zenodo archive files were downloaded — neither of which is recorded in the repository.

mimii_version_or_release.explanation: The repository cites Zenodo record 3384388 (the original MIMII DCASE 2019 release). However, it does not specify whether the full dataset or a subset was downloaded, and does not record which specific Zenodo archive files (e.g. fan_6dB.zip, fan_0dB.zip, fan_-6dB.zip) were used. The file counts on disk (e.g. fan/id_00/normal: 1011 files) are consistent with a single-SNR subset of the original MIMII release, but the specific SNR level cannot be determined from repository evidence alone.

audio_clip_duration.explanation: No clip duration is specified in any repository file. The SDD v4 (docs/sdd/System_Design_Document_v4.md, Section 15, Open Design Question 2) explicitly lists 'Fixed clip duration: confirm against actual MIMII clip lengths' as an unresolved design question. The original MIMII dataset uses 10-second clips at 16 kHz, but this is not stated in the repository.

number_of_audio_channels_in_source_files.explanation: The preprocessing converts to mono (verified from final_method_config.json), but the original channel count of the source .wav files is not stated in the repository. The original MIMII dataset uses 8-channel microphone array recordings, but this is not documented in the repository.
